name: web-ai-showcase runtime pin inventory & allowlist
description: Authorized runtime versions and intentional escape hatches (web-ai-showcase-bm6, web-ai-showcase-xkt, web-ai-showcase-djr). Shared transformers.js pin is 3.7.5; upgrade to 4.3.0 is a staged rollout per reports/transformers-version-policy.md. Raw-ORT pins: 1.21.0 is the consolidated target for the literal-pinned bulk; 1.20.1 is a deliberate, evidence-backed hold (see its reason); migrations are tracked under web-ai-showcase-62m with the full inventory in reports/raw-ort-pins-62m.md. Any new or unlisted pin fails the currency gate.

allowedLocalOverrides.reason: Documented escape hatch for architectures unsupported in 3.7.5 (Sam2Model, Qwen2.5-VL, FastVLM/Docling, LFM2, Ernie, Gemma-3-270m, Apertus)
allowedLocalOverrides.evidence: AGENTS.md version-pin escape hatch; verified in respective worker.js and index.html files

allowedLocalOverrides.reason: Phase 1 staged rollout of 4.3.0 for representative feature-extraction route with verified browser acceptance

allowedVersions.reason: Deliberate hold, 11 routes, do NOT migrate in a version sweep. The 8 VoxPopuli ASR workers (croatian/czech/dutch/german/hungarian/romanian/slovak/slovenian) record real headless-Chrome verification on ORT Web 1.20.1 / WASM EP (real log-probs, coherent transcript), and upstream onnxruntime #23183 documents 1.21.x breaking Segment-Anything-class models on WebGPU. pitch-detection, silero-vad and model2vec-static-embeddings were also built against 1.20.1 and have no measured 1.21.0 run; migrating any of them needs its own real-inference acceptance run (see reports/raw-ort-pins-62m.md).
allowedVersions.evidence: reports/raw-ort-pins-62m.md; worker headers of the 8 VoxPopuli routes; upstream onnxruntime issue #23183; node scripts/raw-ort-inventory.mjs

allowedVersions.reason: Default stable raw-ORT version across majority of raw ONNX routes

bert-base-turkish-cased-ner only. It imports ort.webgpu.min.mjs but its session requests executionProviders:[wasm] — the WebGPU bundle is bundle bloat, not GPU execution, and this is not a WebGPU-verified route. Migration to the 1.21.0 bulk with the wasm bundle is tracked as a child of web-ai-showcase-62m; this pin stays until that real-inference run passes.

manga-ocr only; the previous reason named Model2Vec, which is actually pinned at 1.20.1. It imports ort.all.min.mjs and requests executionProviders:[wasm] — bundle bloat, not GPU execution. Migration to 1.21.0 with the wasm bundle is tracked as a child of web-ai-showcase-62m and also requires creating the missing models/manga-ocr/acceptance.json + run record, because touching the family puts it in acceptance scope.
allowedVersions.evidence: reports/raw-ort-pins-62m.md; models/manga-ocr/worker.js:27 (ORT_URL) vs its executionProviders:[wasm]; models/manga-ocr has no acceptance.json yet
